Uzai_Word_Choice.name: Phoenix
Uzai_Word_Choice.text: (What words did the witness say to the panic-stricken victim?)

Don_Entry_Choice.name: Phoenix
Don_Entry_Choice.text: (The method Don used to enter the ring... That was...)

options.text: He lifted the mesh from below.
options.label: Don_Entry_Choice_Correct

options.text: He was lifted up by wires.
options.label: Don_Entry_Choice_Wrong

options.text: He was hidden inside all along.
options.label: Don_Entry_Choice_Wrong

0.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_moderato,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}Desi says the defendant hit the victim with a prop vase,{nl}but there was never any such thing in the ring.

1.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_moderato,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}I saw every corner of that stage.{nl}My vision is 20/10.

2.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_moderato,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}My vision is 20/10. There's nothing I can't see.

3.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_moderato,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}At the time of the crime, I was by the ring watching{nl}Desi and Yumi's rehearsal.

4.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_moderato,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}Yumi collapsed and didn't move.{nl}There's no way I missed anything at her feet.

0.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_alegro,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}At the time of the crime, I was doing paperwork near the scene.

1.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_alegro,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}During that time, nobody was inside the ring.{nl}That's what it looked like to me.

2.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_alegro,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}Glowing fragments, bloodstains, and such...{nl}I didn't miss something so trivial.

3.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_alegro,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}The stage director, Sal, was just{nl}sitting in the lighting booth.

0.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_moderato,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}Yeah, yesterday I watched the whole thing from the lighting booth.

1.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_moderato,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}When I got closer to the ring, she wasn't moving at all.

2.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_moderato,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}There was nobody else. Just the victim and me.

3.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_moderato,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}Since I could tell from outside that she was dead,{nl}I didn't go inside the fence.

0.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_alegro,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}Entertainment controls this country. And trials are no different.

1.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_alegro,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}I declare it! There is no evidence that I did this!

2.text: {startBGM:interrogatory_alegro,true}{showLifeBar}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1,true}{color:lime}{showTextbox}I weigh 330 pounds. The wire limit is 308 pounds.{nl}Therefore, it's impossible for me to enter the ring!

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {blip:1}And apparently Desi saw the victim bleeding from her arm...

Intro_Start.name: Phoenix
Intro_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Alright, the trial's about to start. I should double-check the facts.)

Intro_Start.name: Maya
Intro_Start.text: {fadeInCharacter}{sprite:Maya["Normal"]}{blip:2}Phoenix, {p:150}looks like this is gonna be a long one.

Courtroom_Opening.name: Judge
Courtroom_Opening.text: {showTextbox}{setSkipEnabled:true}{startBGM:courtroom,true}{courtSprite:judge["Normal"]}{courtView:judge}{blip:1}Court is now in session for the case of Tiara Tenryo.

Courtroom_Opening.name: Judge
Courtroom_Opening.text: {courtSprite:judge["Normal"]}{courtView:judge}{blip:1}Very well. Prosecutor Edgeworth, please present your opening statement.

Courtroom_Opening.name: Edgeworth
Courtroom_Opening.text: {courtSprite:prosecution["Holding_Doc"]}{courtView:prosecution}{blip:1}The defendant, Tiara Tenryo, admits to striking the victim with a vase.{nl}Time of death is estimated between 7:20 PM and 8:12 PM.

Courtroom_Opening.name: Edgeworth
Courtroom_Opening.text: The defendant has already confessed, Your Honor.

{hideTextbox}{playSound:EdgeworthObjection}{playAnimation:Objection_JP}{courtSprite:defense["Determined"]}{courtView:defense}{p:300}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Objection! The defendant said it was a prop vase she used to strike the victim!

Courtroom_Opening.name: Edgeworth
Courtroom_Opening.text: {courtSprite:prosecution["Pointing"]}{courtView:prosecution}{blip:1}It's preposterous. No one would confuse a prop with a real vase.

Courtroom_Opening.name: Edgeworth
Courtroom_Opening.text: The defendant's story is clearly fabricated.

Press_Don_0.name: Don
Press_Don_0.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}You doubt me?{nl}If I say I was there, then I was there!

Press_Don_0.name: Phoenix
Press_Don_0.text: {courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtView:defense}Then was there really no prop vase in the ring?

Press_Don_0.name: Don
Press_Don_0.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}Of course not.{nl}There's no evidence of it anywhere.

Press_Don_1.name: Phoenix
Press_Don_1.text: {playSound:PhoenixHoldIt}{playAnimation:HoldIt_JP}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtPan:defense}{blip:1,true}You said you saw every corner of the stage, didn't you?

Press_Don_1.name: Don
Press_Don_1.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}I am Don. I'm the world's greatest!{nl}There's nothing I can't see.

Press_Don_1.name: Phoenix
Press_Don_1.text: {courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtView:defense}With 20/10 vision, you could see in the dark?

Press_Don_2.name: Don
Press_Don_2.text: {courtSprite:witness["FixGlasses"]}{courtView:witness}Because my vision is 20/10.{nl}That's all the reason I need.

Press_Don_3.name: Phoenix
Press_Don_3.text: {playSound:PhoenixHoldIt}{playAnimation:HoldIt_JP}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtPan:defense}{blip:1,true}What about when the stage was dark?

Press_Don_3.name: Don
Press_Don_3.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}I was by the ring watching{nl}Desi and Yumi's rehearsal.

Don_Evidence_Reveal.text: {bg:Don_Cage}{startBGM:objection}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}In the corner of the photo, there's a clear piece of the broken prop vase!

Don_Evidence_Reveal.name: Judge
Don_Evidence_Reveal.text: {courtSprite:judge["Surprised"]}{courtView:judge}Indeed, the photo clearly shows vase fragments.

Don_Evidence_Reveal.name: Edgeworth
Don_Evidence_Reveal.text: {courtSprite:prosecution["Thinking"]}{courtView:prosecution}It appears the witness was not watching his feet.

Don_Hint_1.name: Phoenix
Don_Hint_1.text: {courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(The ring fragments must have another meaning...)

Second_Opening.name: Phoenix
Second_Opening.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(It's not over yet.{nl}This is where it gets real.)

Second_Opening.name: Edgeworth
Second_Opening.text: {courtSprite:prosecution["Confident2"]}{courtView:prosecution}{blip:1}Even if the vase could be restored,{nl}that doesn't prove the defendant used it.

Second_Opening.name: Phoenix
Second_Opening.text: {courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}Don, you testified earlier, didn't you?{nl}That you saw every corner of the stage?

Second_Opening.name: Don
Second_Opening.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1}That's right, Wright. Actually, I didn't see the scene at all.

Second_Opening.name: Edgeworth
Second_Opening.text: {courtSprite:prosecution["Slamming_Bench"]}{courtView:prosecution}{blip:1}Wait. There is another witness to the murder.

Second_Opening.name: Edgeworth
Second_Opening.text: The stage director who was in the lighting booth at the time: Sal Manella.

Press_Don_2_0.name: Don
Press_Don_2_0.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}Near the scene.{nl}I never said I wasn't watching.

Press_Don_2_1.name: Phoenix
Press_Don_2_1.text: {playSound:PhoenixHoldIt}{playAnimation:HoldIt_JP}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtPan:defense}{blip:1,true}Are you saying no one could have gotten into the ring?

Press_Don_2_1.name: Don
Press_Don_2_1.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}I didn't see anyone.{nl}That should be enough.

Press_Don_2_2.name: Phoenix
Press_Don_2_2.text: {playSound:PhoenixHoldIt}{playAnimation:HoldIt_JP}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtPan:defense}{blip:1,true}You didn't miss the glowing fragments or the blood?

Press_Don_2_2.name: Don
Press_Don_2_2.text: {courtSprite:witness["FixGlasses"]}{courtView:witness}Of course not.{nl}There's nothing I can't see.

Press_Don_2_3.name: Phoenix
Press_Don_2_3.text: {courtSprite:defense["Sweating"]}{courtView:defense}... At that point, {p:150}you could really see everything?

Don_Hint_2.name: Phoenix
Don_Hint_2.text: {courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(So either Sal or Don is the real criminal...)

Uzai_Entrance.text: {hideTextbox}{fadeOutCharacter:400}{fadeOutBg:400}{courtChar:witness,Uzai}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{fadeInCharacter:500}{fadeInBg:500}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Witness. So you're the one who witnessed the actual murder?

Uzai_Entrance.name: Sal
Uzai_Entrance.text: {courtSprite:witness["Angry"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1}Hey now, that's an insult! Of course I did!

Press_Uzai_0.name: Phoenix
Press_Uzai_0.text: {playSound:PhoenixHoldIt}{playAnimation:HoldIt_JP}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}From the lighting booth, you could see the entire ring?

Press_Uzai_0.name: Sal
Press_Uzai_0.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}Yeah, I could see it. That's why I saw the whole thing.

Press_Uzai_1.name: Phoenix
Press_Uzai_1.text: {playSound:PhoenixHoldIt}{playAnimation:HoldIt_JP}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}Was there anyone else at the scene?

Press_Uzai_2.name: Phoenix
Press_Uzai_2.text: {playSound:PhoenixHoldIt}{playAnimation:HoldIt_JP}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}You didn't try to help or anything, just assumed she was dead?

Press_Uzai_3.name: Phoenix
Press_Uzai_3.text: {playSound:PhoenixHoldIt}{playAnimation:HoldIt_JP}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}Sal, are you sure you never went inside the fence?

Press_Uzai_3.name: Sal
Press_Uzai_3.text: {courtSprite:witness["Angry"]}{courtView:witness}What're you trying to say?! I watched from outside the fence!

Uzai_Hint_1.name: Phoenix
Uzai_Hint_1.text: {courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(The paint on Sal's clothes matches the paint on the victim's belt...)

Uzai_Belt_Contradiction.name: Phoenix
Uzai_Belt_Contradiction.text: {courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{startBGM:objection,true}{blip:1}Sal, you're covered in paint spatter all over your clothes!

Uzai_Belt_Contradiction.name: Phoenix
Uzai_Belt_Contradiction.text: The same color paint is also on the belt found near the victim!

Uzai_Belt_Contradiction.name: Sal
Uzai_Belt_Contradiction.text: {courtSprite:witness["Sweating"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1}Huh? N-No way, I don't know anything about that!

Uzai_Belt_Contradiction.name: Phoenix
Uzai_Belt_Contradiction.text: {courtSprite:defense["SlamDesk"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}A test will prove the paint is identical!

Uzai_Word_Choice_Correct.name: Phoenix
Uzai_Word_Choice_Correct.text: {courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}You told the victim "Come over here!" and{nl}took the belt and went inside.

Uzai_Word_Choice_Correct.name: Don
Uzai_Word_Choice_Correct.text: {courtChar:witness,Don}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1}Yumi must have passed the belt through the fence mesh to you.

Uzai_Word_Choice_Correct.name: Sal
Uzai_Word_Choice_Correct.text: ... I was just asked to testify that way.

Uzai_Word_Choice_Wrong.name: Judge
Uzai_Word_Choice_Wrong.text: {courtSprite:judge["Thinking"]}{courtView:judge}{blip:1}... You told someone who couldn't move to come outside?

Uzai_Word_Choice_Wrong.name: Maya
Uzai_Word_Choice_Wrong.text: {courtSprite:cocounsel["Worried"]}{courtView:cocounsel}{blip:2}But... how would words like that lead to Sal going inside?

Don_Recalled.name: Judge
Don_Recalled.text: {courtChar:witness,Don}{courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1}Don. Please return to the witness stand.

Don_Recalled.name: Don
Don_Recalled.text: I'll make you regret putting me in this position. You'll have to listen to my shame.

Don_Recalled.name: Maya
Don_Recalled.text: {courtSprite:cocounsel["Worried"]}{courtView:cocounsel}{blip:2}I feel like we're being made fun of...

Press_Don_Final_0.name: Phoenix
Press_Don_Final_0.text: {playSound:PhoenixHoldIt}{playAnimation:HoldIt_JP}{showTextbox}{courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}That's not true! I won't bow to you!

Press_Don_Final_1.name: Don
Press_Don_Final_1.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}There isn't any. Absolutely none! I'll guarantee it!

Press_Don_Final_2.name: Don
Press_Don_Final_2.text: Which means I could never get inside the ring!

Don_Final_Hint.name: Phoenix
Don_Final_Hint.text: {courtSprite:defense["Thinking"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(That's it... I'll smash this testimony with evidence of Don's crime!)

Don_Cornered.name: Phoenix
Don_Cornered.text: {courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{startBGM:objection,true}{blip:1}A vase with the rim completely shattered. Clear evidence!

Don_Cornered.name: Edgeworth
Don_Cornered.text: {courtSprite:prosecution["Pointing"]}{courtView:prosecution}{blip:1}There were no fingerprints on the murder weapon.

Don_Cornered.name: Phoenix
Don_Cornered.text: You couldn't force Sal to touch the vase!

Don_Entry_Choice_Start.name: Phoenix
Don_Entry_Choice_Start.text: {courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}Your Honor! I've figured out how Don got inside the ring!

Don_Entry_Choice_Correct.name: Phoenix
Don_Entry_Choice_Correct.text: {courtSprite:defense["Pointing"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}He lifted the mesh from below to get inside.

Don_Entry_Choice_Correct.name: Phoenix
Don_Entry_Choice_Correct.text: There's one spot where the barbed wire is slightly bent upward.{nl}That's proof he hooked the belt there!

Don_Entry_Choice_Wrong.name: Desi
Don_Entry_Choice_Wrong.text: {courtSprite:witness["Normal"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1}I used my own belt to get inside the fence and set stuff up as a stage director.

Don_Entry_Choice_Wrong.name: Phoenix
Don_Entry_Choice_Wrong.text: {courtSprite:defense["Sweating"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}... Right. He's not that big, is he?

Don_Entry_Choice_Wrong.name: Phoenix
Don_Entry_Choice_Wrong.text: {courtSprite:defense["Sweating"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}Your Honor, I need to reconsider my answer.

Don_Defeat.name: Phoenix
Don_Defeat.text: {courtSprite:defense["Determined"]}{courtView:defense}{blip:1}Desi went to get the ambulance.{nl}That was your plan all along!

Don_Defeat.name: Don
Don_Defeat.text: {courtSprite:witness["Breakdown"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1}What a blunder... It was a flawless plan...

Don_Defeat.name: Edgeworth
Don_Defeat.text: {courtSprite:prosecution["Determined"]}{courtView:prosecution}{blip:1}The conviction to pursue the truth, and the strength of belief in your client...

Don_Defeat.name: Phoenix
Don_Defeat.text: That's what we have that you don't!

Don_Defeat.name: Don
Don_Defeat.text: {courtSprite:witness["Breakdown"]}{courtView:witness}{blip:1}I will not accept this! I will not end like this!

Verdict_Sequence.name: Judge
Verdict_Sequence.text: {courtSprite:judge["Normal"]}{courtView:judge}{blip:1}Hmm, a most unpleasant trial, but at least the conclusion was satisfying.

Lobby_Epilogue.name: Desi
Lobby_Epilogue.text: {sprite:Desi["Smiling"]}{fadeInCharacter}{blip:2}Hey, I can't stop thinking about{nl}that last thing Don said...

Lobby_Epilogue.name: Phoenix
Lobby_Epilogue.text: {sprite:Phoenix["Confident"]}{blip:1}Well in a weird way, that's actually perfect publicity.{nl}You know, like a viral marketing stunt or something.

Lobby_Epilogue.name: Edgeworth
Lobby_Epilogue.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Edgeworth["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter:300}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Ah, you mean that all the witnesses were lying?

Lobby_Epilogue.name: Maya
Lobby_Epilogue.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Maya["Happy"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter:300}{showTextbox}{blip:2}Plus, I already wrote about this whole thing in my diary.

Lobby_Epilogue.name: Phoenix
Lobby_Epilogue.text: {blip:1}And with that incident behind us, Joyopo's back to being a fun place...
{blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(And so we closed the case. The trial of Don Dupree was finally over.){sectionEnd}
